LESSON: CARE FOR

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 4.1: Care For

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Care For. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. talk about actions that destroy teeth,
2. brush teeth using appropriate brushing material found in one’s locality ,
3. appreciate the need to care for teeth by brushing avoiding eating sugary things. brushing their teeth reinforce teeth brushing (during health check) 135 Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. talk about actions that destroy teeth,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about actions that destroy teeth,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. brush teeth using appropriate brushing material found in one’s locality ,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to brush teeth using appropriate brushing material found in one’s locality ,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the need to care for teeth by brushing avoiding eating sugary things. brushing their teeth reinforce teeth brushing (during health check) 135 Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the need to care for teeth by brushing avoiding eating sugary things. brushing their teeth reinforce teeth brushing (during health check) 135 Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Care For.
2. Explain Care For to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Care For.
4. Show that you can: talk about actions that destroy teeth,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Care For. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Care For important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. talk about actions that destroy teeth,
2. brush teeth using appropriate brushing material found in one’s locality ,
3. appreciate the need to care for teeth by brushing avoiding eating sugary things. brushing their teeth reinforce teeth brushing (during health check) 135 Core-Competences to be developed:
